services.name: Private Burial at Sea
services.desc: Lay your loved one to rest at sea! About We offer private sea burials aboard our comfortable, spacious speedboat. Simply book your preferred date and time, and we'll take your group out to sea for a meaningful ceremony. Understanding the significance of these moments, we strive to make the experience as special and hassle-free as possible. Duration and Burial Location In compliance with federal regulations, we travel 3 miles out to sea before scattering ashes. Most sea burial trips last 1.5 to 2 hours, depending on the length of your personal ceremony. To help preserve the memory, your captain will provide the exact GPS coordinates of the burial location, allowing you to remember the spot

services.name: Private Fishing Charter
services.desc: Rod and Reel Fishing Get out on the water with your private group of up to 6 to get put on some fish. We cater to both seasoned fishermen and newbies! Whether you want to bring your own gear and operate autonomously as your captain takes you too your requested spots or need help with everything, we've got you covered! For new fisherman our captains will help you rig up your rods and and take you to the right spots to put you on some fish. For the experienced fishermen we are open to special requests, just let us know! Stay local and fish the break wall, oil islands, rigs, etc or book a full day 10 hour Catalina Trip. Fishing licenses are required for all those fishing on our charters Rates
